differs: tokensIn includes both caches since Roo 3.29.5 (Task.ts:2662, cost.ts), so uncached input is tokensIn - cacheReads - cacheWrites: task-abc 100 -> 75, task-alpha 1000 -> 450. tokscale and TokenTracker read it as uncached (100 and 1000). tokscale takes the model from the <model> tag in api_conversation_history.json (claude-sonnet-4, claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219); we do not read that file, so those rows are default. TokenTracker counts the api_req_deleted row (800/100); we do not, because an incremental reader already counted the removed rows. The zero api_req_started row gives nothing, and the placeholder counts once when it is back-filled (step 2: +1200/300).
